Package com.j3d.engine.scene.copy

Class CopyProperties

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.scene.copy.CopyProperties
public class CopyProperties extends Object
The properties used when a copy operation is applied. (When calling GObject.copy(CopyProperties)

A callee, gets an existing list of GObject to copy, and creates the CopyOperation. Then after the callee needs to call GObject.copy(CopyProperties) on every single object on the list in order of points, lines and tris. (or else tis thing finna break.)

    • setSoftDependencies

      protected void setSoftDependencies(boolean severeConnections)
      Sets the dependency handling mode for this copy operation. If soft dependencies are enabled, missing dependencies will be created via a supplier. If disabled, an InvalidCopyException will be thrown for missing dependencies.
      Parameters:
      severeConnections - If true, enables soft dependency handling. If false, disables it.

    • existsOrElse

      public <T extends CanCopy> T existsOrElse(UUID id, Supplier<T> supplier) throws InvalidCopyException
      Checks if a copy for the given UUID already exists. If it does, returns the existing copy. If not, and soft dependencies are enabled, it creates a new object using the provided supplier, adds it as a copy, and returns it. If not, and soft dependencies are disabled, it throws an InvalidCopyException.
      Type Parameters:
      T - The type of the object, which must extend CanCopy.
      Parameters:
      id - The UUID of the original object to check for.
      supplier - A Supplier to create a new object of type T if it doesn't exist and soft dependencies are allowed.
      Returns:
      An existing copy or a newly created and added copy.
      Throws:
      InvalidCopyException - If the object with the given ID is not found and soft dependencies are disabled. This exception is handled and re-thrown by StaticRefs.getErrs().
      See Also:
      • setSoftDependencies(boolean)
      • allowsSoftDependencies()
